NewsArticle.Title: Internet Connection
NewsArticle.Content: 04.24 Noon PDT Internet connection may be strained by full Nexus ( [www.NexusTK.com](http://www.nexustk.com/) ) upgrade today. This affects your ability to access the Dark Ages web site and may affect your connection to Dark Ages. If your connection is poor, be safe. Do not risk game death by disconnection. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
